name: hmi_create_screen_group
description: Create a screen group under an exact parent path; on_conflict must be fail and no existing group is overwritten.

group_name.description: Name for the new group; '/' is not allowed.

parent_group_path.description: Exact parent group path; omit or use an empty string for the root.

target_name.description: Exact HMI device, device-item, or software name; required when multiple targets exist.

on_conflict.description: Required conflict behavior; only 'fail' is supported.
